merriles2020.inspection: Author accepted manuscript rendered full text, sections II-IV; PDF unavailable
merriles2020.interpretation: Four thresholds fit assigned error including initial-state population, linewidth and calibration. A possible barrier would make threshold an upper bound; authors argue dense states and four schemes make this unlikely. Quoted error is not total thermochemical or atmospheric accuracy.

hyvo.inspection: Full author-hosted paper including sections3.1-3.2, Table3; official .pf and .def
hyvo.zero: X4Sigma-, v=0, J=0.5, e, F=3 lowest hyperfine component
hyvo.weight: 2F+1 for resolved levels; sum recovers 8*(2J+1). Divide total molecular Q by8 for the nuclear-spin-excluded thermochemical comparison.
hyvo.completeness: 5% separation from broader VOMYT near5400K; reported added outer-level contribution is diagnostic, not a rigorous uncertainty bound.
hyvo.zero_alignment: Absolute fine/hyperfine offset to the legacy JANAF/D0 convention has not been rederived; modern-Q replacement remains a conditional diagnostic.

vomyt.inspection: Publisher article and downloaded official partition file; inventory cross-checked against HyVO full paper
vomyt.version_limit: Downloaded VOMYT Q differs from HyVO2024 Table3 high-temperature column. Report both; neither is silently substituted for the other.

legacy.nasa_reference: Gurvich1982 pt1p62 pt2p64; full Gurvich original not inspected
legacy.atomic_reference: Native JANAF V-005/O-001 for raw JANAF; native NASA V/O for NASA; current hybrid deliberately shares NASA atomic thermal functions.

atmosphere.interpretation: VO rovibronic visible/near-infrared opacity motivates priority despite small mole fraction. Opacity/line-position accuracy does not validate gas-equilibrium abundance; condensation, cold trapping, transport and irradiation remain outside the archived gas-only grid.
